subject.title: Support Azure Foundry GPT Realtime Talk via gateway relay

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor first-class Azure Foundry/Azure OpenAI GPT Realtime Talk in the bundled OpenAI provider now, and what endpoint/auth/config contract should be accepted before implementation?
rationale: The request fits model-provider priorities but crosses provider auth, credential handling, Gateway relay, config, docs, and live Azure availability; automation should not choose API-key versus Entra behavior, redirect policy, or alias/config shape alone.

options.title: Sponsor Azure Gateway Relay Support
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a provider-owned design that keeps Azure credentials on the Gateway, proves the current Azure endpoint shape, and documents the supported config before implementation.

options.title: Defer Until Live Azure Quota Exists
options.body: Keep the item open but do not implement until maintainers have a deployable Azure GPT Realtime resource for live proof.

options.title: Require External Plugin Direction
options.body: Move the Azure realtime path out of core only if maintainers decide the bundled OpenAI provider should not own Azure OpenAI realtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Azure Gateway Relay Support
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a provider-owned design that keeps Azure credentials on the Gateway, proves the current Azure endpoint shape, and documents the supported config before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent supplied the live Azure availability check and has recent Talk/realtime provider history, making them the best available owner for the immediate product/proof decision.
